review_description: Anothony, the owner of the business was a very good sales man and his install team was very good Anothony had recommended the Canadian Solar Panels and the SMA Inverter which I believe is one of the better ones on the market today.
With so many systems and companies selling solar systems it is a difficult decision to make. One can only hope I have made the right decision.

The people I have dealt with at New Eden Solar have been friendly but the level of service is poor. I have not been sent a receipt for my deposit, despite requesting one on a few occasions, nor did I ever receive a welcome letter etc. despite promises. Very poor communication. The system is scheduled to be installed next Monday so fingers crossed that it will be a pleasant experience. I hope I have made the right choice.

I found it hard to pay for something over the net and not get anything in my hand, I also found it difficult to separate the good info and not so good info as I am not an internet person.Again thanks for your help.
